newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Bids in Taiwan diesel sale tender around $29-$31.
newsitem.headline: Bids in Taiwan diesel sale tender around $29-$31.

text.p: Bids in Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp's (CPC) tender to sell diesel were made between $29.00 and less than $31.00 per barrel on a free-on-board (fob) basis from Kaohsiung, a CPC source said on Wednesday.
Taiwan might sell at least two 225,000-to-250,000-barrel cargoes of 0.3-percent sulphur diesel in the tender for November 11-30 liftings, the source said.
The tender, which attracted about 10 bids, closed on October 15 and awards are expected to be made by Thursday, the source said.
In its last tender, CPC sold two diesel cargoes to a Singapore trader and a Swiss trader at just under $27.00 per barrel for October 1-23 lifting, fob Kaohsiung.
